sources.title: Granite 4.1 | IBM Granite
sources.snippet: Granite 4.1 Dense language model family in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes with instruction-tuned variants, delivering improved tool calling, instruction following, coding, and mathematical reasoning.

sources.title: Granite 4.1 8B - OpenModels
sources.snippet: IBM's dense decoder-only 8B parameter language model from the Granite 4.1 family. Supports 131K-token context, tool calling, RAG, code generation with fill-in-the-middle, text summarization, classification, and extraction across 12 languages.
